params.name: economy.trade_qty_max

params.name: economy.wage_max

params.name: economy.xp_per_hour

params.name: economy.xp_per_sale

params.name: finance.account_open_fee
params.summary: Cents that `open_account` costs. The resident pays in cash at the bank.

params.name: finance.bankruptcy_days
params.summary: Game days after a default during which the resident cannot borrow.

params.name: finance.base_rate_bp
params.summary: Yearly base rate of the central bank in basis points. The central banker sets it.

params.name: finance.base_rate_ceiling_bp
params.summary: Highest base rate that the central banker can set.

params.name: finance.base_rate_floor_bp
params.summary: Lowest base rate that the central banker can set.

params.name: finance.book_depth
params.summary: Price levels per side that `market_book` and `shares_book` show.

params.name: finance.deposit_spread_bp
params.summary: The yearly deposit rate is the base rate minus this number, and not below zero.

params.name: finance.drama_central_bank
params.summary: Drama of the central bank events: a rate change, money issued, money retired.

params.name: finance.drama_loan_granted

params.name: finance.loan_limit_max

params.summary: 1: when the answer of an action that waits comes after the action ended (interrupted, cancelled, timed out), the kernel writes the answer as one more report. 0: the kernel drops the late answer.

params.name: kernel.queue_max
params.summary: Greatest number of planned actions in the queue of one resident.

params.summary: Ticks before a routine can fire again after it failed or finished at once. The delay doubles with each failure in a row, up to 16 times.

params.summary: 1: every action that a routine started writes a report, like any other action. 0: only a failed one does, and a success is only counted in the routine. Use 0 when the reports of routines push other notices out of the bounded inbox.

The skill to learn: labor, farming, mining, crafting, cooking,
trading, management, medicine, law, investigation, stealth, combat or
rhetoric.

ticks.description:
Length of the lesson in ticks. One tick is one game minute. Without
it, the lesson has the shortest length.

it, the will names nobody: your spouse inherits, else your city.

one.

locked from the start, so the payment cannot fail.

`by` pays `amount` to the other party when an event happens before
the deadline. When it does not happen, `by` gets the money back.

Data fields that the event must have, for example
`{"target": 42}`. Values are whole numbers, booleans or short
names.

`by` delivers goods before the deadline with `contract_claim`. When
it does not, it breaches the contract.

site.description:
The site where the goods go. When absent, `by` hands them to the
other party in person.

`by` locks `amount`. The other party gets it when `by` breaches the
contract. Else `by` gets it back at the end.

by.description: The party that locks the money.

`society.contract_offer_ttl`.

signs is the other party.
